newTopicsProposed.subject: Mathematics
newTopicsProposed.reason: Records 391-433 of MathBook1 (43 consecutive records, pages 71-76) are entirely function theory: domain and range, composition, inverse functions, one-to-one and onto classification, piecewise definitions, functional equations, and the number of functions between finite sets. None of the canonical Mathematics topics covers this: MAT_ALGEBRA is algebraic and exponential equations, MAT_EQTHEORY is theory of equations and polynomials, and the calculus topics presuppose functions rather than defining them. This is the second canonical gap found in Mathematics, after MAT_PERMCOMB, and for the same reason - the legacy 66-topic list was assembled from a physics-heavy sample. 19 skills in this batch carry this topicKey.

notes: Records 301-450 of MathBook1 (parsed_items.jsonl lines 1989-2138). Coverage: trigonometry and solution of triangles (301-390), functions (391-433), limits and differentiation (434-450). MAT_FUNCTION is PROPOSED, not assumed. Four MAT_TRIG skills minted by b11 and one MAT_COORD_LINE skill from b10 are re-exercised here and listed under reusedExistingSkills rather than re-minted.
